Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: A new CNC program and fixture for BR-220 is a change of manufacturing process. BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which belongs to Aurelia. Aurelia's Supplier Quality Manual revision 4 replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts after a process change. It also requires 90 days' notice of every planned change. Nothing in force covers this change. The change is planned for next week, so the 90-day notice cannot be met. Approval and notification are needed before any shipment.
